RDSTRONG.stands_in_for: this board's termination at the low end of its tolerance, which lowers the reading again

RDWEAK.stands_in_for: this board's termination at the high end of its tolerance, which raises the reading again

RPSTRONG.stands_in_for: a 3.0 A advertisement at the high end of its tolerance, which lowers what a sink reads

RPWEAK.stands_in_for: a 1.5 A advertisement as the specification's own resistor value at the low end of its tolerance, which is the value that raises what a sink reads

VHIGH.stands_in_for: a source at the top of the range the specification permits a resistor pull-up to be referenced to

VLOW.stands_in_for: a source at the bottom of that range

VSHUNT.stands_in_for: the shunt reference as an ideal source at the lowest voltage its datasheet permits over temperature; the assertions carry the comparator's own offset

description: what this board's termination reads from a 1.5 A advertisement at every tolerance that raises the reading, and from a 3.0 A advertisement at every tolerance that lowers it, against the reference they are compared with
name: advertisement_thresholds_at_both_extremes
